releases.notes:
Add a rule to force skylight 15 when checking hostile mob spawn attempts.
The rule does _not_ affect skylight anywhere else, including the F3 screen, only the hostile mob spawning check.

This rule is mainly to simulate snapshot [25w33a](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/minecraft-snapshot-25w33a) where the end dimension has skylight 15 instead of the previous 0.

P.S. I mistakenly incremented the version number again after incrementing it once already some time ago, so we're just skipping v1.4.0.

releases.notes:
Add rules to offset the 3 pack spawn attempts within a single spawn attempt.

- `packOffsetX` and `packOffsetZ`, both default to 0.
- This can be used together with `jumpSequenceX` and `jumpSequenceZ` to allow distinction between mobs in a pack and mobs in different packs.
  - In this example, `fixedInChunk` is used to group them roughly in a grid, then jump sequence runs left-to-right while pack offset runs top-to-bottom:
    ![pack-offset-example](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ffed1a64-0e89-493a-9cc1-079aa2411aeb)
    So we can clearly see the same mob type within any given pack, and possibly different mob types across different packs.

- Adjust `fixedBottomY` behaviour to not spawn anything entirely if the `chunkBottomY` is greater than the heightmap + 1.
  - Previously, the min and max between the `chunkBottomY` and heightmap + 1 was used, which was pretty unintuitive, and this new behaviour also supercedes it by configuring the y range appropriately.

releases.notes:
Add a rule to disable _starting_ spot directly on top of gilded blackstone, but still allows spawning on them.

This is mainly to help test if a spawning skirt has any effects by removing spawns starting on the platform.  
With this rule on, we can more easily separate platform starts from pack spawn skirt starts.

This rule fills in the following truth table:

| Startable | Spawnable | Case |
| :-: | :-: | :-: |
| Yes | Yes | Non-gilded blackstone platform | 
| No | Yes | Gilded blackstone platform |
| Yes | No | (Non-spawnable) Skirt |
| No | No | Column of air |

Note a spawnable skirt is just in the same class as a non-gilded blackstone platform here.

  - Triangular (default)
  - Uniform

  - Custom sequence (e.g. 5, then 1, then -3)
- Whether mobs can spawn within 24 blocks of the player and world spawn point
